use_cases: Social media or contact link sections with bold typography
Navigation menus requiring eye-catching hover effects
Footer or landing page link displays
Portfolio or personal website link sections
ai_summary: A minimalist link component featuring a sophisticated letter-flip animation on hover. Each character in the text flips vertically with staggered timing, creating an elegant reveal effect where the original letters slide up and replacement letters slide in from below. Designed for prominent link displays with bold, uppercase typography at various responsive sizes.
